name: newsletter-drafter
description: Every week or two, picks your new arrivals, best sellers and products back in stock, writes the newsletter in your brand voice and leaves it in Klaviyo as a draft campaign, ready for you to review and send.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Every week, or every two weeks, on the day you choose

howItWorks.label: Picks
howItWorks.text: New arrivals, best sellers and products back in stock, from your own catalog and orders

howItWorks.label: Writes
howItWorks.text: Subject line, preview text and the email, with real names, prices, images and links

howItWorks.label: Leaves
howItWorks.text: A draft campaign in Klaviyo for the list you choose; nothing is sent

plugins.reason: Holds the draft campaign and the list it goes to; you send it from Klaviyo

data.description: The price shown in the email
A public image URL for the product
The product's page on the store, or its handle to build the link from
Whether the product is live on the store
When the product was added, to find new arrivals
The quantity on hand, to leave out sold-out products and spot restocks
Order lines (product, quantity, order date), to find best sellers

parameters.label: When to draft
parameters.description: Every Tuesday at 9:00 by default; the draft is ready for the team to send that week

parameters.label: How often
parameters.description: With every two weeks, every other run is skipped

parameters.label: Klaviyo list or segment
parameters.description: The exact name of the list or segment the campaign goes to

parameters.label: Products per newsletter
parameters.description: How many products to feature in total

parameters.label: The offer
parameters.description: What the email may offer, e.g. "free shipping this weekend with code WEEKEND"; it never invents one
